b082: The tool: Uridine monophosphate (UMP). There's no study showing that "UMP cures DAWS", only more basic research on what uridine, choline, and DHA do in the brain. All three get carried in the blood to the brain, which uses them to make the fatty membranes at its synapses (circulating precursors for brain phosphatide / synaptic membrane synthesis). Wurtman's research group found that giving the three together can increase synaptic membrane components and synaptic proteins, and that in animals, adding UMP to DHA made the neurons grow more new connection points (DHA-induced dendritic spine formation). And in old rats, UMP in their food meant their neurons put out more dopamine when stimulated with potassium, and grew more nerve fibers. So it's plausible that it works on the synapses this way, but using it for DAWS in people means carefully extrapolating from those studies and from anecdotes like Scott's.
b083: Scott added a standard dose of UMP, and within a day his ketamine/LSD cravings fell hard. He already had choline covered with eggs, and took fish oil for DHA/EPA. His psychedelic tolerance seemed to drop too. You can't tell from this whether UMP rebuilt his D3 receptors overnight. In the right person, though, UMP can be a clean signal that the brain was low on what it uses to rebuild synaptic membranes and dopamine receptors. Scott was having vivid dreams again too, with real childhood memories coming back in them.
